strengths: Delivered/cancelled separation is explicit and the desktop history table is concise.

issues.observation: The history table clips estimated value, status and View actions to the right; long request IDs wrap to three/four lines and outweigh buyer/date. A user cannot inspect a request from the visible mobile columns.
issues.recommendation: Use mobile history rows with customer, shortened reference, closed date, value and status plus a visible open action. Preserve complete references in the detail page or copy control.

issues.observation: Four full-width metrics occupy about490px; the two-row history list begins near y930. ‘Historical Requests’, ‘Delivered & Cancelled Requests’ and filter counts repeat the same summary.
issues.recommendation: Use ‘History’ with a compact ‘2 requests ·1 delivered ·1 cancelled’ summary and delivered value beside it. Shorten navigation to ‘Active requests’; remove the second long list heading.

limits: No request opened from table or status changed; current records are local fixture history.

pass2.inspectionConfirmation: Root confirmed all 18 fresh screenshots individually inspected on 2026-09-17.
pass2.notes: Independent fresh desktop/mobile inspection confirmed nearly 500px of stacked mobile metrics and long wrapped IDs; value, status and actions remain offscreen. Sparse desktop space is record density, not a defect.
